1. **Does Treating Vascular Risk Factors Prevent Dementia and Alzheimer's Disease? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.**
   Authors: Susanna C Larsson, Hugh S Markus
   Journal: Journal of Alzheimer's disease : JAD
   Publication Date: 2019-07-15
   PMID: 29914039
   Abstract: Epidemiological evidence has associated Alzheimer's disease (AD) with vascular risk factors (VRFs), but whether treatment of VRFs reduces the incidence of dementia and AD is uncertain.
   URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29914039/
